rules: ALL_SESSION_ADJACENT_CLOSE: absolute log close/previous genuine close > log(1.25)
ALL_SESSION_OPEN_BREAK: absolute log open/previous genuine close > log(1.25)
RTH_ADJACENT_CLOSE: same threshold on consecutive RTH genuine observations, including month/overnight boundaries
SESSION_MEDIAN_SHIFT: absolute log median(first 30 observed RTH closes)/median(previous session last 30 observed RTH closes) > log(1.25)
interpretation: Detection only. No ratio proves a split or vendor error. Symmetric threshold means >25% up or >20% down. Multiple rules at the same ticker/minute merge. Later observations support retrospective event diagnosis only; never model features or admission.
missingness: Canonical excludes conflicts/invalids; proxies never scanned as genuine. Record elapsed time and RTH/EH endpoints. No overnight/holiday interpolation. UTC order and stored exchange-calendar RTH flag; ET dates use America/New_York. All names publicly listed by active July2010 scope; no pre-scope reads.
release: No automatic PASS; every candidate requires external evidence, coherent handling and post-treatment verification. No adjustment or downstream model capability in this scanner.
